name: asistencia-gemb
description: PWA de control de asistencia para la fundación Gimnasio Emocional Mentes Brillantes (GEMB).

scripts.test:reglas: node scripts/emuladores.mjs emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-gemb-reglas "node --test tests/reglas.test.mjs"
scripts.test:varias: node scripts/emuladores.mjs emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-gemb "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/varias-personas.test.mjs"
scripts.test:mcp: npm run build:api && node scripts/emuladores.mjs emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-gemb "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/mcp.test.mjs"
scripts.test: npm run test:reglas && npm run test:varias && npm run test:mcp
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run check:auth && npm run build:api && vite build
